steps.name: Review current branch
steps.command:
branch="$(git branch --show-current)" || { printf '%s
' 'ERROR: unable to determine current worktree branch with git branch --show-current.' >&2; exit 1; }; [ -n "$branch" ] || { printf '%s
' 'ERROR: current worktree is detached; cannot review without a branch.' >&2; exit 1; }; if [ -n "${SHH_REVIEW_DEVICE_UDID:-}" ]; then [ -n "${SHH_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM:-}" ] || { printf '%s
' 'ERROR: SHH_REVIEW_DEVICE_UDID requires SHH_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM.' >&2; exit 1; }; "$REVIEW_SCRIPT" --branch "$branch" --device-udid "$SHH_REVIEW_DEVICE_UDID" --development-team "$SHH_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM"; else "$REVIEW_SCRIPT" --branch "$branch"; fi
